newsitem.title: UK: LME to cease outside storage of aluminium.
newsitem.headline: LME to cease outside storage of aluminium.

text.p: The London Metal Exchange (LME) said on Thursday that outside storage of aluminium in compounds will not be allowed from February 1998.

"...due to the continuing decline in stocks of primary aluminium, the Board of Directors has resolved that with effect from February 1 1998 all LME warranted primary aluminium must be stored inside warehouses and that all compounds will therefore be de-listed from that date," the LME said in a notice to members.
Warehouse companies will have to inform the Exchange when aluminium is moved from compounds into warehouses, the LME said.
Outside storage of aluminium was introduced in 1991, as stocks of aluminium were excessive at that time.
